description: This test file utilizes pytest and FastAPI's TestClient to perform unit tests on a FastAPI application module imported dynamically. It contains fixture setup for creating a test client and two test cases verifying an endpoint response and the OpenAPI schema.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module and initializes a FastAPI TestClient for testing.

methods.name: test_get_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the GET request to '/keyword-weights/' endpoint, checking for status 200 and expected JSON response.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies that the OpenAPI JSON schema returned by the FastAPI app matches expected structure.
